x: These things will continue; and the success the Club has enjoyed will carry on, for the same spirit permeates the younger members. We have walkers like Tony Bellchambers, Ted Elliott, Bob McMullen (Junior), W.

Ted Elliott, for whom we put out an S.O.S in the May Gazette, is about again after a bout of illness and by all accounts is a " Hell of a fellow," and puts the size of our hon. sec. in the shade (with apologies!).
Little, Ted Elliott and Bill True. We believe the latter is somewhere in Dorset.
Ted Elliott, who will be remembered as one of our most promising Junior walkers before the war, writes from the C.M.F. to say that he is doing daily strolls in preparation for his return home.
